newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian army kills six rebels in two-day battle.
newsitem.headline: Colombian army kills six rebels in two-day battle.

text.p: Army troops killed six leftist rebels in two days of combat in the violence-torn banana growing region of northwestern Colombia, military sources said on Sunday.
Regional army commander Gen. Rito Alejo del Rio said fighting broke out on Saturday and continued early on Sunday near the town of Carepa in the Uraba region of Antioquia province.

Alejo said the guerrillas, part of the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the country's largest and oldest rebel army, were heavily involved in the extortion and kidnapping of banana plantation owners.

Uraba is one of the most violent areas in Colombia and has long been the scene of intense conflicts between Marxist guerrillas and right-wing paramilitary groups as they vie for political dominance and the control of lucrative contraband routes.
